texts.preamble: M/S Adani Wilmar Limited vs State Of Rajasthan on 10 January, 2020 High Court Of Judicature For Rajasthan Bench At Jaipur S.B. Criminal Miscellaneous (Petition) No. 4665/2019 M/s Adani Wilmar Limited ----Petitioners Versus State Of Rajasthan ----Respondent
texts.arguments: Learned counsel submits that notices given to them for exercising their option was after a period of one year and in the meantime, the original sample had attained the expiry date and therefore, they have lost the opportunity on account of delay in giving them notice and therefore, now the petitioners ought to be acquitted of the charges. Learned counsel has relied on judgment in the case of Girishbhai Dahyabhai Shah Vs, CC Jani & Anr. reported in 2009(15) SCC 84 where in such similar circumstances, the Supreme Court has [LEAKAGE_MASK] the criminal proceedings. He relies on (2 of 2) [CRLMP-4665/2019] another judgment in the case of Leela Devi & Ors. Vs. State of Rajasthan & Anr. reported in 2013(1) RLW 51 in support of his arguments.
